notes.title: PLAYTEST 0.2 – Ranked abilities, sharper style, deeper cuts
notes.content:
[h3]Hey! Time to jump back into action. Our first major update is here[/h3][p]
And we’ve turned up the heat. Playtest 0.2 brings key improvements that give you more options, better combat feel, and some serious visual upgrades.[/p][p][/p][h3]Ability Rank System[/h3][p]Not all elements are created equal — and not every mining run makes you a god.
Find out which ones are worth the grind and watch your power grow.
Loot planets, stack effects, and build something that [i]actually[/i] shreds.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665697/edb05ab7ba5d3812dc5f553ec0f183f69f6dd82e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]New Ship Visuals[/h3][p]Your base just got a glow-up.
New atmosphere, new details, a fresh coat of cosmic paint — come check out the latest in intergalactic interior design 😎[/p][p][/p][h3]Updated Level Visuals[/h3][p]The world looks better than ever — more depth, more mood, more “oh no, this place is definitely hostile.”
Refreshed lighting and reworked environments are live.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665697/d3c0115409eccca5d425bccccce33c2d2e34d92d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Core Combat Stays – Fast, Fluid, and Tactical[/h3][p]The heart of the game is still there: fast-paced battles, responsive dodging, smart combos.
Slice through enemies, mine elements, craft compounds, and tweak your build to stay alive. Or not.
Boot it up and see how far you get.[/p][p][/p][h3]💬 Tell Us What Hits and What Misses[/h3][p]This update was shaped by your feedback — thanks! And keep it coming. Join our Discord and let us know what hits, what needs love, and what made you yell “yo, that was sick.” 👉 [url="https://discord.gg/azqyUVhZgy"]Join our Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]⭐ Wishlist = Fuel for the Journey[/h3][p]Excited for what’s next? Add the game to your wishlist and stay locked in for more updates.
It also helps us blast through the Steam algorithm galaxy.
👉 Wishlist [i]Stellar Destiny: The Last Survivor[/i] on Steam[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing,
[b]Your dev team[/b] | [i]Stellar Destiny: The Last Survivor[/i][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/azqyUVhZgy" style="button"]Join our Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: PLAYTEST 0.1 – Slash, survive, welcome to the void
notes.content:
[h3]Hey there – this is not the one to skip.[/h3][p]
The first public playtest of Stellar Destiny: The Last Survivor is live — and you’re not here to stargaze. Dive headfirst into [b]the massacre of unknown alien worlds[/b], feel [b]THAT combat rush[/b], meet your first enemies, your ship, and most of all, unleash the raw, unconventional abilities of your player and drone.
[/p][p]Time to slice monsters, test your skills, and build your AI into the deadliest machine in the system.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665697/0b897ce741b2a05231864809b421a57fa58dcc24.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Meet the Ship. And Your Enemies.[/h3][p][/p][p]Welcome aboard your [b]damaged spaceship[/b].
Your AI just booted up — and its first move, in the form of [b]SYNR (Synthetic Runner)[/b], is heading straight toward a planet swarming with merciless enemies.
Get a taste of [b]hostile lifeforms[/b] that won't care who you are, just how fast you die. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665697/38f0d94822873a9de5eeee96447135b8967e4fd9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Combat in the Void – try Playtest 0.1, and you’ll be eagerly waiting for the next update.[/h3][p][/p][p]Test fast, twitchy combat full of [b]dodging, slicing, and raw precision[/b].
Mix high-impact melee with devastating drone strikes, and experiment with your [b]first build paths[/b].
Explore your first [b]unforgiving planets[/b], soak in the atmosphere, and feel how core movement and combat mechanics come together.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]We want to hear from you![/h3][p][/p][p][b]What did you think of your first drop? Not bad, huh? [/b]Got thoughts on combat tempo, the feel of movement, or how the drone handles?
Your feedback moves us forward, so 👉 [url="https://discord.gg/azqyUVhZgy"]join our Discord[/url] and drop us a message about what hit just right. [b]We're there. [/b]And yes, we’re reading it.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Wishlist = your weapon against forgetfulness[/h3][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy the game as much as we love making it. If you don’t want to miss what’s coming next — stay tuned and don’t forget to [b]add Stellar Destiny to your wishlist on Steam[/b] to stay locked in.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing,
[b]Your dev team[/b] | [i]Stellar Destiny: The Last Survivor[/i][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/azqyUVhZgy" style="button"]Join our Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665697/2845c8363e0bb1f9a69f1ab2812f20f063177d2b.png"][/img][/p]
